sentences.en: Hello, and welcome back to my slow English podcast.

phrases.meaning: 歡迎再次來到節目或某個地方

I __went to bed__ last night 《around》 11 p.m.

I __take care of__ myself.

usages.usage: 作副詞，表示比平常或預期時間晚
examples: Today, I __woke up__ 《late》, not early, but 《late》.

usages.usage: 放在時間前，表示大約、不精確
不可數名詞，指工作安排或要上班這件事
examples: I could __sleep in late__ because I didn't have 《work》.

usages.usage: 表示完整足量；full eight hours 指完整八小時
examples: Without my 《full》 eight hours of sleep, I can't **function**.

breakdowns.sentence: Today, I will be talking about sleep and rest.
breakdowns.translation: 今天我要談的是睡眠和休息。

points.label: 未來進行式
points.note: 用 will be talking 表示接下來這集節目將會進行的主題，比單純 will talk 更像節目安排。

breakdowns.sentence: I have been feeling very tired and sleepy.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直覺得很累、很想睡。

points.label: 現在完成進行式
points.note: 表示從過去一段時間開始，一直到現在仍持續的感覺或狀態。

breakdowns.sentence: I haven't had so much energy lately.
breakdowns.translation: 我最近沒有那麼多精神。

points.label: 現在完成式否定
points.note: 用來說明最近到現在的經驗或狀態；had 是 have 的過去分詞。

breakdowns.sentence: I try to get as much rest as I can.
breakdowns.translation: 我盡量多休息。

points.label: as much + 名詞 + as I can
points.text: as much + rest + as + 主詞 + can
points.note: 用來表示「在能力範圍內盡量多」。

breakdowns.sentence: As long as I get a good night's sleep, I think everything else will be perfect.
breakdowns.translation: 只要我睡個好覺，我覺得其他一切都會很完美。

points.label: as long as 條件句
points.text: As long as + 主詞 + 動詞, 主句
points.note: as long as 帶出條件，表示只要前面的條件成立，後面的結果就可能成立。

breakdowns.sentence: I didn't have any early-morning lessons to teach.
breakdowns.translation: 我沒有任何清晨要教的課。

points.label: 名詞 + to V
points.note: to teach 放在 lessons 後面，補充說明這些課是「需要去教的課」。

breakdowns.sentence: Sometimes it's difficult for me to fall asleep at night.
breakdowns.translation: 有時候晚上入睡對我來說很困難。

points.label: It is + 形容詞 + for someone + to V
points.text: It + is + difficult + for me + to fall asleep
points.note: 用 it 當形式主詞，把真正的動作 to fall asleep 放到後面，句子比較自然。

breakdowns.sentence: It's especially frustrating when I have an early class in the morning, when I have to wake up early, because then I don't get my full eight hours of sleep.
breakdowns.translation: 當我早上有早課、必須早起時，這尤其令人沮喪，因為那樣我就睡不到完整八小時。

points.label: when / because 副詞子句
points.text: 主句 + when + 情況 + because + 原因
points.note: when 說明發生情境，because 說明原因，讓一句話同時交代時間條件與理由。

breakdowns.sentence: Without my full eight hours of sleep, I can't function.
breakdowns.translation: 沒有我的八小時睡眠，我就無法正常運作。

points.label: without + 名詞片語表條件
points.text: Without + noun phrase, 主詞 + can't + V
points.note: without 在這裡不只表示「沒有」，也表達「如果沒有這個條件」。

breakdowns.sentence: If I go to sleep late, I usually try to take a nap, a short nap, during the day.
breakdowns.translation: 如果我睡得晚，我通常會試著在白天小睡一下。

points.label: if 真實條件句
points.text: If + 現在式, 主詞 + usually + 動詞
points.note: 用現在式 if 子句描述常發生的情況與通常會採取的做法。

breakdowns.sentence: I can take a 20-minute nap, and I'll feel better, but if I take a 40-minute nap, then I end up feeling more tired than I did before.
breakdowns.translation: 我可以小睡 20 分鐘，然後感覺比較好，但如果我小睡 40 分鐘，最後反而會比之前更累。

points.label: 比較級 + than + did before
points.text: more + 形容詞 + than + 主詞 + did before
points.note: than 後面的 did 代替前面提過的 felt tired，避免重複整個動詞片語。

breakdowns.sentence: I'm so jealous of people who can fall asleep easily.
breakdowns.translation: 我很羨慕那些可以輕鬆入睡的人。

points.label: who 引導關係子句
points.note: who can... 補充說明是哪一種 people，也就是「能輕鬆入睡的人」。

breakdowns.sentence: There are people that can fall asleep so quickly.
breakdowns.translation: 有些人可以很快入睡。

points.label: There are + 名詞 + that 子句
points.text: There are + people + that + can + V
points.note: There are 先提出「有些人」，that 子句再補充這些人的特色。

breakdowns.sentence: I wish I could fall asleep that fast.
breakdowns.translation: 我希望我也能那麼快入睡。

points.label: wish + could
points.note: 用 could 表示與現在事實不同或不確定能否做到的願望。

breakdowns.sentence: I normally have to stop watching my phone or a screen maybe 30 minutes before I go to sleep.
breakdowns.translation: 我通常必須在睡前大約 30 分鐘停止看手機或螢幕。

points.label: stop + V-ing
points.note: stop 後面接 V-ing，表示停止正在做的動作。

breakdowns.sentence: The screen on my phone or computer wakes me up and keeps me awake.
breakdowns.translation: 手機或電腦的螢幕會把我弄醒，讓我保持清醒。

points.label: 使役結構：wake/keep + 受詞 + 補語
points.text: wakes + me + up; keeps + me + awake
points.note: wake me up 表示使我醒來，keep me awake 表示讓我保持清醒。

breakdowns.sentence: I love medicine that makes me feel drowsy.
breakdowns.translation: 我喜歡會讓我感到昏昏欲睡的藥。

points.label: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞
points.note: make 後面接受詞 me，再接原形動詞 feel，表示「使我感到……」。

breakdowns.sentence: I used to sleepwalk all the time when I was little.
breakdowns.translation: 我小時候以前常常夢遊。

points.label: used to + 原形動詞
points.note: 表示過去常常做某事，但現在不一定還會做。

breakdowns.sentence: I would walk around and talk, all while I was still sleeping.
breakdowns.translation: 我會到處走、說話，整個過程我都還在睡覺。

points.label: would 表過去習慣
points.note: would 可用來回憶過去反覆發生的習慣動作。

breakdowns.sentence: When I woke up standing there, I was also confused.
breakdowns.translation: 當我站在那裡醒來時，我也很困惑。

points.label: 分詞片語補充狀態
points.note: standing there 描述醒來當下的狀態：人是站在那裡的。

breakdowns.sentence: I didn't know where I was or how I got there.
breakdowns.translation: 我不知道我在哪裡，也不知道我是怎麼到那裡的。

points.label: 間接問句
points.text: know + where + 主詞 + 動詞 / how + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: where I was 和 how I got there 是句子中的受詞，不用疑問句倒裝。

breakdowns.sentence: Tell me about a time when you sleepwalked at night.
breakdowns.translation: 跟我說說你晚上夢遊過的一次經驗。

points.label: when 引導關係子句
points.text: a time + when + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: when you sleepwalked 補充說明是哪一次經驗。

breakdowns.sentence: People can get scared when I am talking alone at night.
breakdowns.translation: 當我晚上一個人在說話時，人們可能會害怕。

points.label: get + 形容詞
points.note: get scared 表示「變得害怕」，比 be scared 更強調狀態變化。

breakdowns.sentence: Before sleeping, I always wash my face, brush my teeth, set my alarm on my phone, and go to bed.
breakdowns.translation: 睡前，我總是洗臉、刷牙、在手機上設定鬧鐘，然後上床睡覺。

points.label: 介系詞 + V-ing
points.note: before 當介系詞時，後面接名詞或動名詞 V-ing。

breakdowns.sentence: If you liked this video, like and subscribe for more content, and you will probably like these videos as well.
breakdowns.translation: 如果你喜歡這支影片，請按讚並訂閱以查看更多內容，你可能也會喜歡這些影片。

points.label: if 條件子句 + 祈使句
points.text: If + 主詞 + 動詞, 祈使動詞 + and + 主句
points.note: if 子句設定條件，後面用 like and subscribe 直接請觀眾採取行動。
